title: BG2B is the lowest-power Bluetooth LE SoC from Silicon Labs so far
summary: Silicon Labs BG2B is an ultra-low-power Arm Cortex-M33 Bluetooth 6 LE SoC with support for Channel Sounding, Secure Vault High security, and integrated CAN-FD and peripherals such as LED drivers and ADCs for smaller, longer-lasting IoT devices. The company claims it s the lowest-power Bluetooth LE device in its portfolio, with 1.1 A EM2 sleep current with RAM retention, as well as 14%-15% lower MCU active current and lower Bluetooth receive current compared to Silicon Labs BG22/BG22L. The new microcontroller targets secure ranging, asset tracking, electronic shelf labels (ESLs), smart home, industrial monitoring, and vehicle diagnostics. title: ChronoWatch X2040 A DIY watch with off-the-shelf Raspberry Pi RP2040 round display, 3D printed case, and custom firmware
summary: If you ve ever wanted to build your own watch, the ChronoWatch X2040 DIY watch allows you to do it the easy way with a Waveshare RP2040-Touch-LCD-1.28 touch LCD board, a 3D-printed case, a 3.7V LiPo battery, a few screws, and firmware using the Pico C/C++ SDK.
